blocks.label: Overview
bullets: Helps Kids Fall Asleep & Stay Asleep Longer
paragraphs: Co-developed with a sleep scientist to support your kids' sleep. Expertly formulated for effective, 100% drug-free sleep support you can trust.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Kids 4 years and older, start with 1 gummy and give up to 2 gummies as needed 30 minutes before bedtime, for occasional use. Chew each gummy thoroughly.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Organic tapioca syrup, organic cane sugar, pectin, citric acid, sodium citrate, color added (organic black carrot juice concentrate), natural flavors, lo han guo (monk fruit) extract, organic sunflower oil, organic carnauba wax.
Free of synthetic colors, gluten, wheat, milk, eggs, peanuts, sesame, soy, tree nuts, fish, and shellfish.
Manufactured in USA from domestic and imported ingredients.
This product does not contain common GE genes or proteins.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Store in a cool dry place. Do not freeze. Product may darken over time.

Keep out of reach of children. For use under adult supervision only. Consult your child's health care provider before use if they have a medical condition, are on any medications, have a medical procedure planned , or for ongoing sleep difficulties. Discontinue use and consult your doctor if any adverse reactions occur. Do not use with any medications/drugs or supplements that can induce sleep or drowsiness, or that contain melatonin. This product is not a substitute for a regular bedtime routine or to treat insomnia or other sleep disorders. Intended for occasional use only. Do not exceed recommended serving. Do not use if inner safety seal is broken.
